Gist: This turn is the demo. Your turn was recorded when you sent it, as `turn-6VOQjn.json`, with no summary yet and nothing sent to 象. That's right for the new path: it goes to 象 only when this reply ends, with the first 5 lines of this reply attached. If you look first, `turn-6VOQjn.json` should gain a `happened_summary` field when this reply ends, and a matching `turn-6VOQjn.json.analysis.json` should appear once 象 has read it.

**What I checked just now:** the record exists in `~/.emacs-graph/session-turn-analysis/`. It's marked `requested`, with this session's id, turn `claude-17-turn-285`, and its evidence id. It has no `happened_summary` and no analysis file yet.

**What the summary will hold:** only the opening lines of this reply. I made no commits this turn, so there will be no commit lines. I didn't make a commit just to show one.

**How to tell it worked, beyond the files:** after you've sent your next turn, press `g` in the stepper. This turn should then appear as a complete frame, since the stepper leaves out unread turns. If 象's reading doesn't arrive, the record stays `requested` and the frame stays hidden, so the failure is visible rather than silent.
